tetchily.def: in an ill-natured and tetchy manner
examples: `Are you sure?' he asked her tetchily
he dealt with the problem of evil theologically, not philosophically
the candidate was found theologically sound

thermostatically.def: by thermostat; in a thermostatic manner
examples: the temperature is thermostatically controlled
our rent increased threefold in the past five years

traditionally.def: according to tradition; in a traditional manner
examples: traditionally, we eat fried foods on Hanukah
thinly overgrown mountainside

thinly.def: in a small quantity or extent;
examples: spread the margarine thinly over the meat
apply paint lightly
the blood was flowing thin
smiled thinly
a used towel that he had used and had left thriftily on the ledge below the mirror rather than consign to the linen basket
he lives thriftlessly from day to day

timorously.def: in a timorous and trepid manner

trepidly.def: in a timorous and trepid manner

examples: the shoes fit me tip-top
`Come in,' she said tonelessly
the geological environment is the primary factor in determining the character of a country not only topographically but historically
tortuously haggling over the price
he touchily refused all offers to help
toughly vigorous story-telling

transcendentally.def: in a transcendental way or to a transcendental extent

examples: these three pions may actually be joined together transiently as a compound particle during the interchange process

transitionally.def: as a transitional step or in a transitional manner

transparently.def: so as to allow the passage of light
examples: the red brilliance of the claret shines transparently in our glasses

transparently.def: so as to be easily understood or seen through;
examples: his transparently lucid prose
his transparently deceitful behavior
the leaves rustled tremulously in the wind

trenchantly.def: in a vigorous and effective manner
examples: he defended his client's civil rights trenchantly
tritely expressed emotions
trivially motivated requests
we can prove trivially that this theorem is false
it was tropically hot in the greenhouse
the boy looked up truculently at his teacher
they strive for security by truculently asserting their own interests

tumultuously.def: in a tumultuous and riotous manner
examples: the crowd was demonstrating tumultuously

tutorially.def: by tutorials; in a tutorial manner
examples: undergraduates are better taught tutorially
the price increased twofold last year
they had not done any work theretofore
he whistled tunelessly
closely related taxonomically

topologically.def: from the point of view of topology
